name: Ishita Saini
lead: An interior designer who thrives at the intersection of design and people.
description: It started with a fascination for how a room could change the way someone feels the moment they walk into it. An interior designer who started out learning the craft at Gaurang Patel Architects and sharpened it further at Livspace, working across AutoCAD, SketchUp, V-Ray, and Enscape. The real challenge was always bridging the gap between a client's imagination and the finished space — so I focus on managing every project end-to-end, from Experience Center walkthroughs to site visits, making sure nothing gets lost along the way. What I love most is the moment a concept approved on paper becomes a space someone walks into and calls home.

I pour my heart into every project, driven by an insatiable desire to create extraordinary spaces. This portfolio showcases my signature style - where elegance, innovation, and an artist's touch converge to elevate the human experience. From luxurious residences to dynamic commercial environments, each design is a testament to my unwavering commitment to exceeding client expectations.
